data.one_liner: Dart-only i18n library providing string extensions for translation, plural and gender handling.
data.what_it_does: It adds extension methods to String for translating text based on locale maps. Supports pluralization, gender modifiers, and default locale setting without Flutter widgets.
use_when: You need i18n in pure Dart or server-side code
You want lightweight translation without Flutter dependencies
You prefer extension‑method API over ARB files
avoid_when: You need Flutter widget integration like I18n widget
You rely on code‑generated localization (e.g., intl)
strengths: Works in any Dart environment (Flutter or server)
weaknesses: Limited tooling compared to intl (e.g., IDE extraction)
Documentation focuses on core usage; Flutter docs are separate

alternatives.name: intl
alternatives.why_pick_it: Standard Flutter/Dart localization with ARB files and code generation

alternatives.name: easy_localization
alternatives.why_pick_it: Provides Flutter widgets and easy JSON/YAML based translations

alternatives.name: slang
alternatives.why_pick_it: Offers code generation for type‑safe translations and IDE support
